understanding: Passive serial_data monitor observing DUT-output stx_pad_o as tx and DUT-input srx_pad_i as rx for RS232 external-device communication without driving, depending on t_bringup_clk clock and reset order, reconstructing frame transactions for downstream comparison with reset flush.
preconditions: Bring-up t_bringup_clk complete with stable clock at fixed period per test and reset deasserted with SYM_IDLE_CYCLES idle before sampling
serial_data monitor bound observe-only to RTL ports stx_pad_o and srx_pad_i with no driver enabled in monitor and SRX driving owned outside monitor
Symbolic SYM_LINE_FORMAT and SYM_BIT_CYCLES configuration references available for sampling without invented values
check_steps: SAMPLE stx_pad_o as DUT-output tx and srx_pad_i as DUT-input rx on each clock without driving either pad [f_stx_dir f_srx_dir]
IF reset asserted THEN flush partial tx and rx frame state and shift-register state and WAIT for reset deassertion plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES before resuming SAMPLE
FOR each start-bit detected on stx_pad_o RECONSTRUCT one tx frame transaction using symbolic SYM_LINE_FORMAT and SYM_BIT_CYCLES with mid-bit sampling reference and PUBLISH to tx analysis port
FOR each start-bit detected on srx_pad_i RECONSTRUCT one rx frame transaction using symbolic SYM_LINE_FORMAT and SYM_BIT_CYCLES with mid-bit sampling reference and PUBLISH to rx analysis port
NEVER drive srx_pad_i or stx_pad_o from monitor and NEVER compare tx against itself or rx against itself
completion: WAIT until all reconstructed tx and rx transactions are published and consumed or TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES testbench operational limit expires
CLEANUP flush partial frames and return monitor to idle observe-only state and release sampling handles

questions: What LCR-controlled SYM_LINE_FORMAT including data_bits parity and stop_bits must the monitor use to delimit tx and rx frames?
What divisor-latch plus clock-period combination defines SYM_BIT_CYCLES and mid-bit sampling point for stx_pad_o and srx_pad_i reconstruction?
Which framing parity and break attributes must be attached to reconstructed tx and rx transactions and how is break-hold distinguished from idle?
What reset assertion level and sequencing must trigger monitor flush of partial frames and shift-register state and what pad idle state applies during reset?
How must tx and rx analysis streams be routed to downstream comparison without self-comparison and without including configuration traffic?
